subQuestions.label: b)
subQuestions.text:
A random variable has the following probability function:
| x | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 | 6 | 7 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| P(x) | 0 | K | 2K | 2K | 3K | K$^2$ | 2K$^2$ | 7K$^2$ + K |
Determine:
i) k
ii) mean
iii) variance
subQuestions.latex: \sum P(x) = 1 \implies 10K^2 + 9K - 1 = 0. \text{ Mean } E(X) = \sum x P(x). \text{ Variance } Var(X) = E(X^2) - (E(X))^2.
